author: Michael Larabel
description: Linux 7.1-rc2 is out for testing with its accumulation of initial bug and regression fixes that have been collected over the past week since the Linux 7.1 merge window was capped off...
title: Linux 7.1-rc2 Released With Audio Fix For Steam Deck OLED, Other Fixes

author: Michael Larabel
description: Brush v0.4 debuted today for this "Bourne Rusty Shell" as a Bash/POSIX-compatible shell written in the Rust programming language...
title: Brush v0.4 Released As "Significant" Release For This Rust-Based Shell

author: Michael Larabel
description: ReactOS as the "open-source Windows" operating system project striving for binary compatibility with Microsoft Windows has seen some exciting improvements this week...
title: ReactOS Introduces Unified Live/Install Media, New Storage Driver

author: Michael Larabel
description: This week Google announced the selected Google Summer of Code "GSoC" 2026 projects for providing stipends to student developers for engaging in different open-source projects. This year a lot of open-source projects involve AI/LLM adoption but there are also a number of other interesting student projects at large from GNOME Mutter GPU reset recovery to adding new features to FreeBSD...
title: Many Exciting Google Summer of Code 2026 Projects & A Lot Of AI

author: Michael Larabel
description: It's been an interesting 2026 in Linux development with beginning to phase out i486 CPU support, dropping ISDN and amateur "ham" radio support, and other code cleaning in the name of a diminishing user base -- or perhaps even no users left -- for those running such vintage hardware with a modern, up-to-date kernel. Yet ISA sound card drivers have seen an uptick in activity...
title: Turtle Beach WaveFront ISA Sound Cards Seeing Suspend/Resume Support On Linux In 2026

author: Michael Larabel
description: One of the interesting GNOME-aligned application developments in recent months has been RustConn as a modern GTK4-based connection manager. RustConn allows managing SSH, RDP, VNC, SPICE, and a variety of other connections from this Rust-written application. It's been steadily tacking on more features and that effort continued with more features landing...
title: The GNOME-Aligned RustConn Connection Manager Continues Piling On More Features

author: Michael Larabel
description: One of the most prominent changes with the upcoming Linux 7.1 kernel release is the introduction of the new NTFS driver in the Linux 7.1 kernel. This new driver provides more features and better performance than the Paragon NTFS3 driver that's been in the kernel the past few years and far better off than the original NTFS read-only driver that previously was in the kernel and for which this new driver is based. Needless to say it's also a big improvement over the NTFS-3G user-space FUSE driver too...
title: New NTFS Driver Sees More Fixes With Linux 7.1-rc2
